item.title: Correction · 1515 3rd St, one of the two buildings of Uber's Mission Bay headquarters campus (1455 and 1515 3rd St): Earlier entries said Uber is…
item.description: Earlier entries said Uber is 'now shown as no longer at 1515' 3rd St. That is an inference, not something a source states. Uber's FY2025 annual report gives its principal executive offices as 1725 3rd Street and says Uber owns 'two adjacent office buildings, Mission Bay 1 & 2', without naming 1515 or saying Uber left it. The Real Deal (October 29, 2023) reported that Uber leased two of the four buildings of its Mission Bay headquarters to OpenAI and 'will continue to occupy the remaining buildings on its campus'. DataSF business registrations still list an Uber Technologies registration at 1515 3rd St with no end date. Whether Uber has left 1515 is not confirmed. Source: Uber Technologies, FY2025 annual report, Form 10-K (https://s23.q4cdn.com/407969754/files/doc_events/2026/May/04/2025-Annual-Report.pdf); The Real Deal, 2023-10-29 (https://therealdeal.com/san-francisco/2023/10/29/openai-subleases-two-san-francisco-buildings-from-uber/); DataSF Registered Business Locations (https://data.sf.gov/resource/g8m3-pdis.json).

item.title: Correction · 1515 3rd St, one of the two buildings of Uber's Mission Bay headquarters campus (1455 and 1515 3rd St): OpenAI's status at 1455 and…
item.description: OpenAI's status at 1455 and 1515 3rd St stays 'announced', a 2023 expected state from lease reports. Reports in 2026 say OpenAI now occupies more than 1 million square feet in Mission Bay and has subleased two buildings from Uber at 1455 and 1515 Third Street, but none names either building as occupied or gives a move-in date, so no opening is shown. The sources are listed in each record's open questions. Source: SF Standard, 2026-02-26 (https://sfstandard.com/2026/02/26/open-ai-mountain-view-expansion/); Hoodline, 2026-01-09 (https://hoodline.com/2026/01/openai-poised-to-gobble-up-dropbox-mission-bay-hq-space/); The Real Deal, 2026-03-16 (https://therealdeal.com/san-francisco/2026/03/16/openai-inks-another-mission-bay-lease/); SF Standard, 2023-10-27 (https://sfstandard.com/2023/10/27/openai-uber-headquarters-mission-bay/); DataSF Registered Business Locations (https://data.sf.gov/resource/g8m3-pdis.json).

item.title: Correction · 1515 3rd St, one of the two buildings of Uber's Mission Bay headquarters campus (1455 and 1515 3rd St): OpenAI at 1515 3rd St is now…
item.description: OpenAI at 1515 3rd St is now shown as announced (an October 2023 lease report) rather than open since December 2024, because the December 2024 date is only a business-registration start. Uber is shown as closed at 1515 because its FY2025 annual report gives 1725 3rd St and the building was reported leased to OpenAI in 2023; the earlier FY2022 filing is what had made it look open. The completion milestone is now 2021 (Assessor), with ArchDaily's 2022 noted, instead of June 2021; the pile-driver milestone links its SocketSite post; and the unsourced 'Uber Mission Bay 2' name was dropped from the notes. Source: SF Standard, 2023-10-27 (https://sfstandard.com/2023/10/27/openai-uber-headquarters-mission-bay/); DataSF Registered Business Locations (https://data.sfgov.org/Economy-and-Community/Registered-Business-Locations-San-Francisco/g8m3-pdis); Uber Technologies, FY2025 annual report (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1543151/000154315126000015/uber-20251231.htm); DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls, parcel 8721029 (https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json?parcel_number=8721029); ArchDaily (https://www.archdaily.com/1006339/uber-headquarters-shop-architects); SocketSite, 2016-09 (https://socketsite.com/archives/2016/09/uber-about-to-start-building-new-san-francisco-hq.html).
